properties.name: Ambient
properties.doc: Light added everywhere, indoors and out: the ground half of the ambient light.

properties.name: OutdoorAmbient
properties.doc: Light from the open sky, added to Ambient from above.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.doc: How strong the sun is; 0 turns it off.

properties.name: ClockTime
properties.doc: The time of day in hours (0 to 24); it sets where the sun is.

properties.name: TimeOfDay
properties.doc: The time of day as "HH:MM:SS"; the same value as ClockTime.

properties.name: GeographicLatitude
properties.doc: The latitude in degrees; it tilts the sun's path.

properties.name: FogStart
properties.doc: Distance from the camera, in studs, where the fog begins.

properties.name: FogEnd
properties.doc: Distance from the camera, in studs, where the fog is opaque.

properties.name: FogColor
properties.doc: The colour of the fog.

properties.name: ExposureCompensation
properties.doc: Brightens (positive) or darkens (negative) the whole lit scene, in stops.

properties.name: GlobalShadows
properties.doc: When false the sun casts no shadows.

properties.name: ColorShift_Top
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: A tint added to surfaces facing the sun.

properties.name: ColorShift_Bottom
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: A tint added to surfaces facing away from the sun.

properties.name: EnvironmentDiffuseScale
properties.note: Stored; the hemisphere ambient is always used.
properties.doc: How much the sky lights surfaces.

properties.name: EnvironmentSpecularScale
properties.note: Stored; reflections come from the hemisphere ambient.
properties.doc: How much the sky is reflected.

properties.name: ShadowSoftness
properties.note: Stored; the shadow filter is fixed.
properties.doc: How soft shadow edges are.

methods.name: GetSunDirection
methods.doc: The unit vector from the world's origin towards the sun at the current ClockTime.

methods.name: GetMoonDirection
methods.doc: The unit vector towards the moon: opposite the sun.

methods.name: SetMinutesAfterMidnight
methods.doc: Sets ClockTime from minutes after midnight.

classes.name: Atmosphere
classes.note: Drawn as fog and a horizon tint: Density and Haze thicken the fog, Color tints it and the horizon; Offset, Decay and Glare are stored only.
classes.doc: Haze in the air, under Lighting: it fades distant objects and colours the horizon.

properties.name: Density
properties.doc: How thick the air is (0 to 1).

properties.name: Offset
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: How far the haze starts from the camera.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The colour of the haze.

properties.name: Decay
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: The colour of the haze away from the sun.

properties.name: Glare
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: A glow around the sun.

properties.name: Haze
properties.doc: Extra haze near the horizon (0 to 10).

classes.name: Sky
classes.note: The sky is a gradient with a sun disc; skybox images are stored, not drawn.

properties.name: SkyboxBk
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's back side.

properties.name: SkyboxDn
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's bottom side.

properties.name: SkyboxFt
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's front side.

properties.name: SkyboxLf
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's left side.

properties.name: SkyboxRt
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's right side.

properties.name: SkyboxUp
properties.note: Stored; skybox images are not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the sky's top side.

properties.name: SunTextureId
properties.note: Stored; the sun is a plain disc.
properties.doc: The image of the sun.

properties.name: MoonTextureId
properties.note: Stored; the moon is not drawn.
properties.doc: The image of the moon.

properties.name: SunAngularSize
properties.note: Stored; the disc has a fixed size.
properties.doc: The sun's size in degrees.

properties.name: MoonAngularSize
properties.note: Stored; the moon is not drawn.
properties.doc: The moon's size in degrees.

properties.name: CelestialBodiesShown
properties.doc: When false the sun disc is not drawn.

properties.name: StarCount
properties.note: Stored; stars are not drawn.
properties.doc: How many stars show at night.

classes.name: PostEffect
classes.doc: What every screen effect under Lighting or the camera has.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the effect is not applied.

classes.name: BloomEffect
classes.doc: Makes bright parts of the image glow.

properties.name: Intensity
properties.doc: How strong the glow is.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: How far the glow spreads.

properties.name: Threshold
properties.doc: How bright a pixel must be to glow.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: How strong the blur is.

classes.name: ColorCorrectionEffect
classes.doc: Changes the brightness, contrast, saturation and tint of the 3D view.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.doc: Added to every colour channel.

properties.name: Contrast
properties.doc: Stretches colours away from mid grey (positive) or towards it.

properties.name: Saturation
properties.doc: Strengthens (positive) or weakens colours; -1 is grey.

properties.name: TintColor
properties.doc: Multiplies the image.

classes.name: SunRaysEffect
classes.doc: Rays of light from the sun past objects.

properties.name: Intensity
properties.doc: How bright the rays are.

properties.name: Spread
properties.doc: How far the rays reach.

classes.name: DepthOfFieldEffect
classes.note: Stored; the renderer has no depth of field yet.
classes.doc: Blurs what is nearer or farther than the focus.

properties.name: FarIntensity
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: How blurred things beyond the focus are.

properties.name: FocusDistance
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: How far from the camera the focus is, in studs.

properties.name: InFocusRadius
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: How deep the sharp zone around the focus is, in studs.

properties.name: NearIntensity
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: How blurred things in front of the focus are.

classes.name: Light
classes.doc: What every light has. A light shines from its parent part or attachment.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.doc: How strong the light is.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The light's colour.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the light is off.

properties.name: Shadows
properties.note: Stored; only the sun casts shadows.
properties.doc: Whether the light casts shadows.

classes.name: PointLight
classes.doc: Light in every direction from its parent.

properties.name: Range
properties.doc: How far the light reaches, in studs (at most 60).

classes.name: SpotLight
classes.doc: A cone of light from one face of its parent.

properties.name: Range
properties.doc: How far the light reaches, in studs (at most 60).

properties.name: Angle
properties.doc: The cone's full angle in degrees (at most 180).

properties.name: Face
properties.doc: The face of the parent part the cone points out of.

classes.name: SurfaceLight
classes.note: Drawn as a spot light from the centre of the face, not from the whole face.
classes.doc: Light out of one face of its parent part.

properties.name: Range
properties.doc: How far the light reaches, in studs (at most 60).

properties.name: Angle
properties.doc: The spread of the light in degrees (at most 180).

properties.name: Face
properties.doc: The face the light comes out of.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.doc: Where the camera is and where it looks (along its -Z axis).

properties.name: Focus
properties.doc: The point the camera looks at, for detail and sound around it.

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.doc: The vertical field of view in degrees (1 to 120).

properties.name: FieldOfViewMode
properties.note: Only Vertical; other modes read as Vertical.
properties.doc: Which angle FieldOfView measures.

properties.name: CameraType
properties.note: Custom and Scriptable; the other types behave as Scriptable.
properties.doc: How the camera moves: Custom follows CameraSubject through the default camera script, Scriptable leaves CFrame to scripts.

properties.name: CameraSubject
properties.doc: What the Custom camera follows: a Humanoid or a part.

properties.name: ViewportSize
properties.doc: The size of the 3D view in pixels, written each frame.

properties.name: NearPlaneZ
properties.doc: The near clipping plane, in studs along the camera's -Z axis.

methods.name: WorldToScreenPoint
methods.doc: The screen pixel (minus the top bar) of a world point, with its depth in Z, and whether it is in front of the camera and inside the view.

methods.name: WorldToViewportPoint
methods.doc: The viewport pixel of a world point, with its depth in Z, and whether it is in front of the camera and inside the view.

methods.name: ScreenPointToRay
methods.doc: A unit ray from the camera through a screen pixel (below the top bar), starting depth studs out.

methods.name: ViewportPointToRay
methods.doc: A unit ray from the camera through a viewport pixel, starting depth studs out.

methods.name: GetRenderCFrame
methods.doc: The frame the camera is drawn from: its CFrame.

properties.name: CastShadow
properties.doc: When false the part casts no shadow.

properties.name: Reflectance
properties.note: Approximated: the surface gets smoother and more metallic; nothing is mirrored.
properties.doc: How mirror-like the part is (0 to 1); drawn as a smoother, shinier surface.

properties.name: LocalTransparencyModifier
properties.doc: Extra transparency on this machine only, for example the local character in first person.

classes.name: Highlight
classes.doc: Draws an outline and a fill over a part or model.

properties.name: Adornee
properties.doc: The part or model highlighted; the parent when empty.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false nothing is drawn.

properties.name: DepthMode
properties.doc: AlwaysOnTop shows through other objects; Occluded only where the object is seen.

properties.name: FillColor
properties.doc: The colour drawn over the object.

properties.name: FillTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the fill is.

properties.name: OutlineColor
properties.doc: The colour of the outline.

properties.name: OutlineTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the outline is.

classes.name: Beam
classes.note: Drawn without its texture; LightInfluence and Brightness are stored only.
classes.doc: A strip drawn between two attachments.

properties.name: Attachment0
properties.doc: Where the beam starts.

properties.name: Attachment1
properties.doc: Where the beam ends.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the beam is not drawn.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The colour along the beam.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.doc: How see-through the beam is along its length.

properties.name: Width0
properties.doc: The width at Attachment0, in studs.

properties.name: Width1
properties.doc: The width at Attachment1, in studs.

properties.name: CurveSize0
properties.doc: How far the curve bends out along Attachment0's X axis.

properties.name: CurveSize1
properties.doc: How far the curve bends in along Attachment1's X axis.

properties.name: Segments
properties.doc: How many straight pieces the curve is drawn with (1 to 1000).

properties.name: FaceCamera
properties.doc: When true the strip turns to face the camera.

properties.name: LightEmission
properties.doc: How much the beam adds light to what is behind it (0 to 1).

properties.name: LightInfluence
properties.note: Stored; beams are unlit.
properties.doc: How much scene light colours the beam.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: Multiplies the beam's light.

properties.name: ZOffset
properties.note: Stored; not used.
properties.doc: Moves the beam towards the camera when sorting.

properties.name: Texture
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: An image along the beam.

properties.name: TextureLength
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: How long the image is, in studs.

properties.name: TextureMode
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: How the image fits the beam.

properties.name: TextureSpeed
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: How fast the image moves.

classes.name: Trail
classes.note: Drawn without its texture; LightInfluence and Brightness are stored only.
classes.doc: A ribbon left behind two moving attachments.

properties.name: Attachment0
properties.doc: One edge of the trail.

properties.name: Attachment1
properties.doc: The other edge.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false no new trail is left; what is there fades out.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The colour over the trail's life.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.doc: How see-through the trail is over its life.

properties.name: Lifetime
properties.doc: How long each piece lasts, in seconds.

properties.name: MinLength
properties.doc: How far the attachments move before a new piece is added.

properties.name: MaxLength
properties.doc: The longest the trail gets, in studs; 0 for no limit.

properties.name: WidthScale
properties.doc: Scales the width over the trail's life.

properties.name: FaceCamera
properties.doc: When true the trail turns to face the camera.

properties.name: LightEmission
properties.doc: How much the trail adds light to what is behind it (0 to 1).

properties.name: LightInfluence
properties.note: Stored; trails are unlit.
properties.doc: How much scene light colours the trail.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: Multiplies the trail's light.

properties.name: Texture
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: An image along the trail.

properties.name: TextureLength
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: How long the image is, in studs.

properties.name: TextureMode
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: How the image fits the trail.

methods.name: Clear
methods.doc: Removes the trail drawn so far.

classes.name: ParticleEmitter
classes.note: Particles are camera-facing soft spots without textures; VelocityInheritance, LockedToPart and Orientation other than FacingCamera are stored only.
classes.doc: Sends out particles from its parent part or attachment.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false no particles are sent out by Rate; Emit still works.

properties.name: Rate
properties.doc: Particles sent out per second.

properties.name: Lifetime
properties.doc: How long each particle lives, in seconds, picked in this range.

properties.name: Speed
properties.doc: The starting speed in studs per second, picked in this range.

properties.name: SpreadAngle
properties.doc: How far, in degrees, particles stray from the emission direction about X and Y.

properties.name: Acceleration
properties.doc: Added to every particle's velocity each second.

properties.name: Drag
properties.doc: How fast particles slow down: speed halves every 1/Drag seconds.

properties.name: EmissionDirection
properties.doc: The face of the parent the particles leave from.

properties.name: Shape
properties.doc: Where particles start: in a box, sphere, cylinder or disc the size of the parent.

properties.name: ShapeInOut
properties.doc: Whether particles move out of the shape, into it, or both.

properties.name: ShapeStyle
properties.doc: Whether particles start inside the shape or on its surface.

properties.name: ShapePartial
properties.note: Stored; the whole shape is used.
properties.doc: The part of the shape particles start from (0 to 1).

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The colour over a particle's life.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.doc: How see-through a particle is over its life.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: A particle's size in studs over its life.

properties.name: Squash
properties.note: Stored; particles are drawn unsquashed.
properties.doc: Stretches a particle over its life: positive is taller and thinner, negative wider and shorter.

properties.name: FlipbookLayout
properties.note: Stored; particles are drawn without their texture.
properties.doc: How the texture is split into flipbook frames.

properties.name: FlipbookMode
properties.note: Stored; particles are drawn without their texture.
properties.doc: How the flipbook frames play.

properties.name: FlipbookFramerate
properties.note: Stored; particles are drawn without their texture.
properties.doc: Flipbook frames per second.

properties.name: FlipbookStartRandom
properties.note: Stored; particles are drawn without their texture.
properties.doc: When true each particle starts on a random flipbook frame.

properties.name: WindAffectsDrag
properties.note: Stored; there is no wind.
properties.doc: When true, Drag pulls particles towards the workspace's wind.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.doc: The starting rotation in degrees, picked in this range.

properties.name: RotSpeed
properties.doc: The turning speed in degrees per second, picked in this range.

properties.name: LightEmission
properties.doc: How much particles add light to what is behind them (0 to 1).

properties.name: LightInfluence
properties.note: Stored; particles are unlit.
properties.doc: How much scene light colours particles.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.note: Stored; not drawn.
properties.doc: Multiplies the particles' light.

properties.name: TimeScale
properties.doc: Speeds up (above 1) or slows down the particles' motion and ageing.

properties.name: VelocityInheritance
properties.note: Stored; not used.
properties.doc: How much of the parent's velocity particles take.

properties.name: LockedToPart
properties.note: Stored; particles stay where they were sent out.
properties.doc: When true particles move with the parent.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.note: Particles always face the camera.
properties.doc: How particles turn.

properties.name: ZOffset
properties.note: Stored; not used.
properties.doc: Moves particles towards the camera when sorting.

properties.name: Texture
properties.note: Stored; effects are drawn without textures.
properties.doc: The particle image.

methods.name: Emit
methods.doc: Sends out this many particles at once.
